start_here: Say to your AI: "Try the qwen3 voice-cloning model on my narration line in line.json, cloned from ref.wav and ref.txt, keeping the best of 3 tries per sentence."

lists.label: Settings
lists.holds: One row per tool and scope (a person, a film, a piece or the whole account): the settings that tool reads when it runs, as JSON.

instructions: 1. Check ref.wav is your own voice or one you have consent to clone; put its exact words in ref.txt (qwen3 needs them).

2. Pour the example settings rows into your list:settings (see pour) if you want your own takes, models and reference. If you keep a list:settings row for this folder (record:setting:compare-voice-and-music-models~film~<film>) your AI reads it with tool:read-a-tool-setting, saves it to a file and adds --settings-record that file --film <film>; its values go over the defaults.

3. Say the line in start_here. Your AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: "tool:say-a-narration-line-in-a-cloned-voice-model"}, installs mlx-audio, mlx-whisper, numpy and soundfile if missing and runs the command in given.

4. Read the last line: {"result": {take, engine, model, sample_rate, units, word_errors}}. Tell the person the licence: Pocket TTS is CC-BY-4.0 (credit Kyutai); Chatterbox output carries an inaudible watermark.

worked_examples.title: Each unit made 3 times, the one whisper heard best kept
worked_examples.ask: Try the qwen3 clone on my narration line.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/do-work/say_a_line_in_a_cloned_voice.py; best-of-N is tested in tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/test/test_voice_ab.py (Clone): for unit 1 three tries heard as "Close.", "Clothes.", "Close." have errors [0, 1, 0] and kept_errors 0; the one with the fewest word errors wins, then the length nearest the median. line.json = {"script":"Close. The kettle is on... and the toast is burning. Aren't you, Morwenna?","units":["Close.","The kettle is on... and the toast is burning.","Aren't you, [Morwenna](/mɔːwˈɛnə/)?"],"pause_after":[0.65,0.4,0.0],"inner_most":0.45,"hear_prompt":"Morwenna.","voice_reference":"reference-take.wav","vowel_check":{"word":"close"}}. Run: python3 -I tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/do-work/say_a_line_in_a_cloned_voice.py line.json qwen3 take-qwen3.wav --ref ref.wav --takes 3
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result":{"take":"take-qwen3.wav","engine":"qwen3","model":"mlx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base-bf16","sample_rate":<the model's rate>,"units":"take-qwen3.units.json","word_errors":<sum of the kept units' errors>}}: take-qwen3.units.json holds, per unit, what each of the 3 tries was heard as, all_errors (unit 1: [0,1,0]) and kept_errors. With an unknown engine: {"error":"nope is not an engine here: use one of chatterbox, pocket, qwen3, or add it to clone_engines"}; qwen3 with no ref.txt: {"error":"qwen3 needs the exact words of the reference: pass --ref-text, a file of them (ref.txt is not there)"}.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
